description: Source code for a class 'quality_test' that performs various PEP-8 compliance checks on Python files within a specified module directory, including import placement, spacing, licensing, loop queries, sequence checks, boolean comparisons, and more.

classes.name: quality_test
classes.description: A class that extends 'base_module_quality.abstract_quality_check' to perform PEP-8 style and best practice checks on Python files in a given directory.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the quality_test object with default parameters and descriptive attributes.

methods.name: run_test
methods.description: Executes the style checks on Python files within the specified module path, aggregating results and scoring.

methods.name: check_import
methods.description: Checks that import statements are correctly placed at the top and on separate lines.

methods.name: check_licence
methods.description: Verifies presence and position of copyright and license declarations in files.

methods.name: check_loop
methods.description: Detects usage of certain methods inside loops which is discouraged.

methods.name: check_space
methods.description: Checks for improper spacing before punctuation characters like commas, semicolons, and colons.

methods.name: check_space_operator
methods.description: Checks for excessive spacing around operators.

methods.name: check_len
methods.description: Ensures sequence length checks follow best practices (e.g., using 'if seq:' instead of 'len(seq) > 0').

methods.name: check_boolean
methods.description: Detects comparisons of boolean values to True or False using '==' or '!='.

methods.name: get_result
methods.description: Formats the overall test result into a table.

methods.name: get_result_general
methods.description: Generates an HTML report summarizing the findings.
